physics.criterion: The deployed rod mass equals its initial deployed mass plus actual material entering the injector outlet minus material leaving the evaluation domain.
Every evaluated material interval preserves its reference arc length. Changing the rod shape, coil pitch, or endpoint span must not be achieved by stretching its material.
At each equilibrium sample, actual elastic cut forces and external loads sum to zero on every evaluated rod subdomain, not merely on the rod as a whole.
At each equilibrium sample, force moments and free couples balance on every evaluated rod subdomain, including internal sections hidden from the camera.
